name: execution-serve
title: Sandbox host: serve this server's sandboxes to execution-remote over HTTP
description: A sandbox host: the sandboxes of this App's workspace provider (execution-gondolin's VMs), over HTTP for execution-remote, behind a shared token.

environment.name: PIKIT_SANDBOX_TOKEN
environment.description: The token execution-remote clients send (the same value in their projects); at least 32 characters (for example `openssl rand -hex 32`). Never reaches a sandbox.
